latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Music — Add Music to Videos Free

- Instantly add royalty-free background music to your video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB)
- Easy onboarding: automatic setup with free 7-day token for 100 credits
- Simple prompts route actions like upload, export, credits, and track previews
- All exports rendered in the cloud; returns high-quality 1080p MP4s in under a minute
- Built-in error handling for file size, format, session token, and free plan limits
- Ideal for creators seeking copyright-free music with fast turnaround
